mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of UNRATE > 0.3pp rise instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declines, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during manufacturing slowdown regimes.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months reflects strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of RSAFS 3-month uptrend periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and nonfarm payrolls declines indicate labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE rise and PAYEMS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100.5 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
